prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement along a stone-paved path surrounded by dense foliage under a cloudy, foggy night sky. The camera pans slightly to reveal an old, ivy-covered building partially obscured by mist, its windows dark and unlit. As the viewer progresses, the path winds through thick shrubs and trees, the ground occasionally uneven with patches of grass and exposed roots. The camera angle shifts subtly, capturing the misty atmosphere that envelops the scene, diffusing the limited light and creating a hazy, ethereal ambiance. The environment is quiet and devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the solitude of the setting. The path continues to meander, revealing more of the overgrown landscape, with occasional glimpses of rocky outcrops and distant silhouettes of trees shrouded in fog. The muted colors of the night—shades of gray, green, and brown—are accentuated by the soft, diffused light filtering through the clouds, enhancing the serene yet mysterious quality of Shengshan Island's natural surroundings. The camera maintains a consistent forward motion, providing a continuous and immersive experience of navigating this tranquil, fog-laden outdoor scene.
